mechanism_narrative: The recent two-week upward trend in RETAIL_REC mobility, moving from -13.3% to -9.7%, indicates a sustained recovery in consumer activity that will continue to drive RETAIL_REC higher over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: The mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is equal to or lower than the mean RETAIL_REC over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: The sharp increase in GROCERY_PHARM mobility from -0.3% to 2.1% in the last week signals a significant increase in essential out-of-home activity, which will quickly translate to a positive spillover effect on RETAIL_REC within the next week.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM rises by more than 2 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase in the week following a week where GROCERY_PHARM rose by more than 2 points.

mechanism_narrative: The combined trend of decreasing RESIDENTIAL mobility (from 6.1% to 4.4%) and recovering PARKS mobility (from -28.7% to -6.0%) indicates a broader shift towards out-of-home activities, which will positively impact RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than the last 28 days, despite RESIDENTIAL continuing to fall and PARKS continuing to rise.

mechanism_narrative: Given the decision time point of November 15, the impending winter season and likely tightening of public health restrictions will reverse any recent positive mobility trends, leading to a decline in RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than or equal to the mean RETAIL_REC over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: The significant and sustained recovery in PARKS mobility, rising from -28.7% to -6.0% over the last two weeks, demonstrates a strong public willingness to engage in outdoor activities, which will translate to increased RETAIL_REC within the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by more than 10 points week-on-week for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase in the two weeks following a period where PARKS rose by more than 10 points for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: Despite minor fluctuations, the persistently low levels of TRANSIT and WORKPLACES mobility (around -30% and -8% respectively) indicate a continued absence of routine commuting, which will suppress RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC shows a sustained increase over the next four weeks, despite TRANSIT and WORKPLACES remaining significantly below baseline.

mechanism_narrative: The concurrent decrease in RESIDENTIAL mobility (less time at home) and stable, slightly recovering WORKPLACES mobility suggests a gradual return to pre-pandemic routines, which will lead to a modest increase in RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC declines or remains flat over the next two weeks, despite RESIDENTIAL continuing to fall and WORKPLACES remaining stable or rising.

mechanism_narrative: The seasonal shift to colder weather in mid-November will inherently reduce outdoor activities and general willingness to leave home, leading to a decline in RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks, especially impacting categories that benefit from incidental foot traffic.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC maintains or increases its current levels over the next four weeks, despite the onset of winter.
